items.title: The Language of Instruction: Genre and Generative AI
items.summary: The article posits instruction‑fine‑tuned language models as a distinct genre, the instructional‑conversational genre, formed by recursive human‑model dialogue.
items.whyItMatters: It reframes how we evaluate and design AI interactions, impacting model transparency and user trust.

items.title: SceneBloom: Agentic Indoor Environment Generation with Realistic and Diverse Layouts for Embodied Learning
items.summary: SceneBloom generates realistic, diverse indoor 3D layouts for embodied AI training, combining language guidance with visual generative models for spatially coherent scenes.
items.whyItMatters: It enables more robust, generalizable agent learning by providing varied, physically valid environments.

items.title: RobustRLlib: A Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
items.summary: RobustRLlib unifies robust RL algorithms into a reusable library and benchmark, addressing reusability and empirical limits for real‑world deployment.
items.whyItMatters: It streamlines testing and comparison of robust RL methods, speeding up reliable AI system development.

items.title: DexPort: A Hand-Held Skill Interface for Dexterous Hand Data Collection
items.summary: DexPort introduces a handheld interface that captures human hand motions for robot manipulation, easing data collection for dexterous tasks.
items.whyItMatters: It streamlines training robots by simplifying demonstration capture and reducing operator effort.

items.title: Flownomaly: Single-Step Conditional-Mean Recovery for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
items.summary: Flownomaly recovers normal images in frozen DINOv2 feature space using a velocity field, enabling few-shot anomaly detection without relying on exemplars or linear models.
items.whyItMatters: It offers a more flexible, exemplar-free approach that could improve anomaly detection in resource‑constrained industrial settings.

items.title: Measure Before You Train: Typed Decision Models vs. a Classical Baseline vs. a Generative LLM for Routing a Personal Multilingual Inbox
items.summary: The article introduces Foyer, a self-hosted inbox agent that uses typed decision models, a classical baseline, and a generative LLM, and presents a protocol for measuring its performance.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers care because it offers a transparent, measurable approach to improving personal email automation.

items.title: Where Rounding Happens Matters: Rounding-Location Alignment Stabilizes LLM Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: The article explains how mismatched rounding between inference and training in LLM reinforcement learning can cause off‑policy updates and instability.
items.whyItMatters: Tech readers should know that precise numerical alignment is critical for reliable LLM training performance.

items.title: Beyond Discrete Tokens: Preserving Numerical Continuity in Medical Vision-Language Models
items.summary: The paper introduces HAD-VLM, a hybrid autoregressive-diffusion model that integrates text generation with continuous ultrasound measurement prediction.
items.whyItMatters: It enables precise, prompt-driven quantitative medical imaging, improving diagnostic accuracy and workflow efficiency.

items.title: Monetizing Intelligence: Advertising and Subscription Design on LLM Platforms
items.summary: The paper analyzes how an LLM platform balances ad revenue, subscription pricing, and response quality to maximize profits while managing user value.
items.whyItMatters: Tech readers should understand how monetization choices shape AI service quality and user experience.

items.title: Knowledge Distillation across Item and Code Spaces for Parallel Generative Recommendation
items.summary: The paper proposes a knowledge distillation method that transfers knowledge between item and code representations to improve generative recommendation models.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers care because it enhances recommendation accuracy and efficiency by leveraging semantic codes.

items.title: If at First You Don't Succeed, Backtrack: Lightweight Recovery for Frozen VLAs
items.summary: Backtrack offers a lightweight, failure-detection and recovery method for frozen Vision‑Language‑Action models in robotic manipulation.
items.whyItMatters: It lets robots self‑correct without costly retraining or extra models, boosting reliability in real‑world tasks.

items.title: Learning Positive Linear Combinations of ReLUs in Fully Polynomial Time
items.summary: The paper presents a fully polynomial-time algorithm for PAC-learning positive linear combinations of k ReLU units over ℝ^d with Gaussian inputs and L₂ loss.
items.whyItMatters: It enables efficient training of ReLU ensembles, improving scalability for high-dimensional, large-scale machine learning tasks.

items.title: Yalda-Embedding: Open Development of a Competitive Persian Retrieval Model
items.summary: Despite advances in multilingual text representations, effective dense retrieval for Persian remains constrained by the limited availability of language-specific training resources and compact embedding models. items.title: ZENO: Nonlinear filtering with Zakai Equation Neural Operators
items.summary: State inference and parameter learning for nonlinear filters is a core computation for scientific machine learning with varied applications in engineering and neuroscience. items.title: Adaptive Frequency Threshold Byte Pair Encoding for Mixed Natural Language and Structured Symbolic Corpora
items.summary: Modern language models rely on subwording tokenization to define the discrete units of input processing, typically using methods like Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) that treat whitespace as a fixed semantic boundary. items.title: SemantEq: Faithful Bidirectional Equivalence of Formal Statements
items.summary: Statement autoformalization translates mathematics from natural language into a proof assistant such as Lean 4, and models now do it at scale. As provers get stronger, the burden of correctness shifts from the proof to the statement, that is, to whether the formal statement faithfully translates its source. items.title: A Tutorial on Physics Constrained Machine Learning for Hybrid Modeling, Optimization, and Control
items.summary: Physics-constrained machine learning (PCML) integrates domain knowledge, first-principles, and physical constraints into AI/ML models. In this work, we present a step-by-step tutorial of a modular PCML framework, KKT-HardNet, and illustrate how it could be used for hybrid modeling, process simulation, optimization and model predictive control in a single platform. items.title: Recommender regret for improving regularised RL estimation with bandits and MCTS
items.summary: Regularised reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms rely on estimators, like Monte Carlo tree search or one-step look-ahead, to provide policy, value, or Q-value estimates in training and inference. However, existing bandit-based estimation frameworks evaluate sampling efficiency, not the quality of estimates. items.title: LoCA: Enabling Multi-Modality in Geospatial Location Encoders
items.summary: Location encoders map geographic coordinates to high-dimensional descriptors through contrastive alignment with paired Earth Observation imagery. We prove that this construction is structurally limited: any Lipschitz location encoder produces an output of intrinsic dimension at most 2, regardless of architecture or bandwidth, which forces the contrastive loss to strictly exceed its asymptotic…

items.title: Green Code or Costly Code? Evaluating the Energy Costs of Iterative LLM-Based Code Optimizations
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to optimize code for performance. This practice often assumes that improvements in execution speed naturally translate into overall lower energy consumption.
